items.question: How many pollutants does the Air Quality Index (AQI) used on the UAE National Air Quality Platform consider?
items.gold: Five pollutants: ground-level ozone, particulates, sulfur dioxide, carbon monoxide and nitrogen dioxide.
items.fact: AQI considers five pollutants, including ozone and particulates

items.question: On the UAE National Air Quality Platform, what AQI range is classified as 'Good'?
items.fact: AQI 0-50 is classified as 'Good' air quality
